raw.details:
About the Hackathon:

  • Founder's Code 2026 is a 24-hour AI hackathon designed to challenge students to go beyond coding and develop solutions to real-world problems.
  • Participants will:
  • Identify a problem
  • Build an AI-powered solution
  • Develop a working prototype
  • Understand the user and market
  • Present and pitch the product
  • The competition combines technical execution, product thinking and business innovation.

Participation Options:

  • Tech Pass

  • Team Size: 1–4
  • Suitable for students interested in AI/ML, software development, full-stack development, data science and coding.

  • Biz Pass

  • Team Size: 1–2
  • Suitable for students interested in entrepreneurship, startups, product management, business strategy, marketing and customer discovery.

  • Tech + Biz Pass

  • Team Size: 1–4
  • For students interested in combining technology with entrepreneurship and product development.

Competition Flow:

  • Online Preliminary Round
  • Evaluation & Shortlisting
  • 24-Hour Offline Hackathon at Chennai
  • Product Demonstration & Final Presentation
  • Final Evaluation & Awards
  • Students should be prepared to demonstrate a working solution, not merely a presentation.

What Students Should Be Ready to Show:

Technical:

  • Working prototype
  • Functional implementation
  • Technical innovation
  • Problem-solving approach
  • Live demonstration

Business/Product:

  • Problem and target users
  • Product value proposition
  • User adoption strategy
  • Market opportunity
  • Sustainability/business model

Prizes:

  • Winner: ₹25,000
  • Second Prize: ₹15,000
  • Third Prize: ₹10,000
  • Total Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000
  • Additional opportunities mentioned by the organisers include Pre-Placement Interviews (PPIs), incubation access and venture-grant opportunities with partners.

Who Can Participate:

  • Students and aspiring innovators interested in:
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Software Development
  • Product Development
  • Entrepreneurship
  • Startups
  • Innovation
  • Technology
  • Business
  • Students may participate individually or form teams according to the selected participation category.

Why Participate:

  • Build a real product.
  • Work with a team.
  • Solve a real-world problem.
  • Demonstrate your technical skills.
  • Develop entrepreneurial thinking.
  • Present before industry experts.
  • Compete for a ₹1,00,000 prize pool.
